scope: Human TNFSF15/TL1A archived experimental coordinate quality control. No interventions or designs.
public_observation_scope: Two archived reference depositions and their previously published QC results. No new endpoint of a potential third deposition examined before this freeze.

query_union: wwPDB polymer entity for human TNFSF15 mapped via UniProt official cross-references or PDBe mapping from current or historical accession
RCSB entry search by TL1A, TNFSF15, or tumor necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 15
search.fallback: If a search endpoint is unavailable, archive successful Union branches and failed URLs/status, and disclose search scope.
search.snapshot: Save request and original response hashes and timestamps. Use release date <= search day. If the archive contains future-dated releases, exclude them.

priorities: Verified independent sample/data collection relative to both references
Earliest original public PDB release in eligible group
Lowest numeric target polymer entity ID
Three lexicographically first distinct deposited target label_asym_ids in coordinate model 1

eligibility.origin: Human TNFSF15 by deposited reference sequence, taxonomy/gene or UniProt crossreference and alignment. Include described complex, mutation or tagging as scope attributes.
eligibility.experiment: Experimental PDB model, physical sample and primary data. Three modelled deposited polypeptide chains of same target construct in one model/asymmetric unit. No symmetry operators or alternative models as substitutes for observed copies.
eligibility.sampling: Require a distinct acquisition, supported by the experimental record or its methods. X-ray evidence can be a dated new diffraction collection separated from both recorded collection dates plus distinguishable specimen/crystal or diffraction conditions, or a primary report explicitly documenting original sample and new collection. For a different experimental method require independent collection metadata and original sample preparation report. Different PDB ID, DOI, re-refinement or expanding symmetry alone is insufficient. Explicit reuse excludes. Unclear or missing provenance remains pending.
eligibility.alignment: Reference is 2RE9 entity 1 label entity_poly_seq. Map canonical SEQRES by global alignment, match 2, mismatch -1, gap open -5, extend -1; keep mapped reference/target positions only for identical residues. Accept a window when mappings of its positions agree across optimal alignments; otherwise mark ambiguous. Distinct target chain labels never identify equivalent cross-specimen copies.
eligibility.availability: For each named mask, use only model 1 ATOM identity/presence (backbone N,CA,C,O or CA). Count matching residue identities in all three chains and the union. Original >=60 positions and >=60% of union; within window >=10 comparable positions; after removal >=60 and >=60% of original. Mark missing positions. At least one mapped window and mask must satisfy these rules. Supply only qualifying choices to the blinded operator.
eligibility.public_endpoint: Coordinates and prior reference results are public; archive metadata/catalog supports eligibility. Never claim worldwide novelty, unseen training data, or independent biological samples among the three pairs.
eligibility.endpoint_embargo: No use of x/y/z values for screening. No fitting, distances, RMSDs, rotation angles or leave-out results for new materials. Do not sort on or look for endpoint answers.

selection: Choose first eligible in frozen ranking. Preserve every excluded/pending candidate; eligible once enrolled stays enrolled. Blind code is opaque and must not encode accession. Keep identity crosswalk & raw bytes outside Lead workspace. No qualified entrant leaves the question unanswered.
